svg.title: Beyond mise
svg.desc: Stacked area chart of cumulative GitHub stars since January 2025 for jdx's tools other than mise: 9.56k stars in total, about 1.94k a year earlier. jactionlint 360, mr boxington 811, aube 2075, fnox 2422, hk 1361, pitchfork 723, usage 1086, +5 more 723.

g.text: $ gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/stargazers --paginate # every tool except mise
cumulative stars since Jan 2025, stacked by launch
